latest.title: Uniqueness of tangent flows in free boundary flow
latest.abstract: We prove uniqueness of tangent flows for mean curvature flow with free boundary at singularities modeled on half-cylindrical self-shrinkers. More precisely, if a tangent flow is of the form $\mathbb{S}^{n-k} \times \mathbb{R}^k_+$ or $\mathbb{S}^{n-k}_+ \times \mathbb{R}^k $, then it is unique. This provides the free-boundary analogue of the uniqueness theory for cylindrical singularities.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 证明带自由边界平均曲率流在半圆柱型自相似收缩子奇点处的切流唯一性，覆盖球面乘半空间和半球面乘欧氏空间两类模型。
techniques: 加权能量与漂移热方程
latest.breakthrough: 补齐了柱状奇点唯一性理论的自由边界版本；结合已知内部圆柱结果，统一处理三类圆柱模型。
latest.limitations: 只处理具有指定半圆柱切流的奇点，并不覆盖一般自由边界奇异模型或给出完整奇点分类。
latest.priorityReason: 切流唯一性是奇点结构与后续正则性分析的核心，结果直接扩展成熟理论到自由边界环境。
